document_title: Advisory on Pink Bollworm Management in Cotton
text:
### 1. Identification and Damage Symptoms
Pink bollworm (*Pectinophora gossypiella*) attacks cotton flowers and bolls.
- Larvae bore into flower buds and rosette flowers appear.
- Larvae enter tender bolls, bore into developing seeds, causing stained lint and boll rot.
- In Marathi: कापसावरील गुलाबी बोंडअळीच्या प्रादुर्भावामुळे फुले 'रोझेट' (गुलाबाच्या आकारासारखी) होतात आणि बोंडे सडतात.
- In Hindi: गुलाबी सुंडी के प्रकोप से फूल मुड़कर गुलाब के आकार जैसे बन जाते हैं और गूलर के अंदर बीज व रुई नष्ट हो जाती है।

metadata.publisher: ICAR - Central Institute for Cotton Research (CICR), Nagpur

document_title: Advisory on Pink Bollworm Management in Cotton
text:
### 2. Economic Threshold Level (ETL)
- 8 to 10 adult moths trapped per pheromone trap per night for 3 consecutive days, OR
- 10% damaged green bolls with live larvae.

metadata.publisher: ICAR - Central Institute for Cotton Research (CICR), Nagpur

document_title: Advisory on Pink Bollworm Management in Cotton
text:
### 3. Integrated Management Measures
1. **Pheromone Traps (फेरोमोन सापळे / फेरोमोन ट्रैप)**: Install 5 to 8 pheromone traps per hectare at 45 to 60 days after sowing for monitoring. For mass trapping, install 20 to 25 traps per hectare.
2. **Biological & Bio-pesticides (जैविक नियंत्रण / जैविक उपाय)**:
   - Release *Trichogramma bactrae* egg parasitoids @ 1,50,000 per hectare at weekly intervals.
   - Spray 5% Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE) or Neem Oil 1500 ppm @ 5 ml per litre of water at initial stage (नीम का तेल / कडुनिंब तेल फवारणी).
3. **Approved Chemical Controls (रासायनिक फवारणी / रासायनिक छिड़काव)**:
   - Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC (क्लोरेंट्रानिलिप्रोल / क्लोरँट्रानिलिप्रोल) @ 3 ml per 10 litres of water, OR
   - Emamectin benzoate 5% SG @ 4 grams per 10 litres of water.
   - **In Hindi**: नियंत्रण के उपाय: 5 से 8 फेरोमोन ट्रैप लगाएं, नीम का तेल 1500 ppm का छिड़काव करें या क्लोरेंट्रानिलिप्रोल 18.5% SC 3 मिली प्रति 10 लीटर पानी में मिलाकर छिड़कें।
   - **In Marathi**: नियंत्रण उपाय: हेक्टरी 5 ते 8 फेरोमोन सापळे लावा. सुरुवातीला कडुनिंब तेल 1500 ppm फवारावे किंवा प्रादुर्भाव जास्त असल्यास क्लोरँट्रानिलिप्रोल 18.5% SC 3 मिली प्रति 10 लिटर पाण्यात फवारावे.
   - **Safety Warning**: Wear protective gear. Do not spray during windy conditions. Do not overdose. Always consult the local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) or Agriculture Officer before application.

document_title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) Crop Insurance Guide
text:
### 1. Objectives and Coverage
PMFBY provides comprehensive insurance coverage against non-preventable natural risks from pre-sowing to post-harvest:
- Prevented sowing / planting risk.
- Standing crop loss due to drought, dry spells, flood, inundation, pests & diseases, landslide, natural fire, storm.
- Post-harvest losses (up to maximum 14 days after harvest for crops cut and spread for drying).
- Localized calamities (hailstorm, cloud burst, excessive unseasonal rain).

metadata.publisher: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / PMFBY Directorate

document_title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) Crop Insurance Guide
text:
### 2. Farmer Premium Rates
The premium payable by farmers is extremely low and subsidized:
- **Kharif Food and Oilseed Crops**: Maximum 2.0% of Sum Insured.
- **Rabi Food and Oilseed Crops**: Maximum 1.5% of Sum Insured.
- **Annual Commercial / Horticultural Crops**: Maximum 5.0% of Sum Insured.
- Balance premium is shared equally between Central and State Governments.

metadata.publisher: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / PMFBY Directorate

document_title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) Crop Insurance Guide
text:
### 3. Crucial Timeline for Claim Intimation (72-Hour Rule)
- For localized calamities or post-harvest loss, the farmer **MUST intimate crop loss within 72 hours** of the occurrence.
- Intimation channels:
  1. Crop Insurance App (फसल बीमा ऐप) on mobile.
  2. Toll-Free Number: 14447.
  3. Agriculture Officer / KVK or concerned Bank / Insurance company agent.
- In Hindi: प्राकृतिक आपदा से नुकसान होने पर ७२ घंटे के भीतर सूचना देना अनिवार्य है।
- In Marathi: नैसर्गिक आपत्तीमुळे नुकसान झाल्यास ७२ तासांच्या आत विमा कंपनीकडे किंवा Crop Insurance App वर तक्रार नोंदवणे अनिवार्य आहे.

document_title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) Guidelines
text:
### 1. Scheme Benefits
- Financial benefit of ₹6,000 per year is provided to eligible farmer families having cultivable landholding.
- Amount is transferred directly into Aadhaar-linked bank accounts in three equal installments of ₹2,000 every 4 months (April-July, August-November, December-March).
- In Hindi: पात्र किसान परिवारों को प्रति वर्ष ₹6,000 की वित्तीय सहायता तीन समान किश्तों में दी जाती है।
- In Marathi: पात्र शेतकरी कुटुंबांना दरवर्षी ₹६,००० चा लाभ तीन हप्त्यांमध्ये थेट बँक खात्यात जमा केला जातो.

metadata.publisher: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India

document_title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) Guidelines
text:
### 2. Mandatory Requirements for Installment Credit
To receive PM-KISAN installments, farmers must complete:
1. **e-KYC**: Must be completed via OTP on PM-KISAN portal/app, or biometric authentication at CSC (Common Service Centre).
2. **Land Seeding (भूलेख अंकन / जमीन पडताळणी)**: Farmer's land records (Khasra/Khatauni or 7/12 extract) must be verified and seeded on the portal by state revenue officials.
3. **Aadhaar Bank Seeding**: Bank account must be seeded with Aadhaar and enabled for NPCI direct benefit transfer (DBT).

metadata.publisher: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India

document_title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) Guidelines
text:
### 3. Exclusions
- Institutional landholders, government employees, income tax payees in previous assessment year, and pensioners with monthly pension above ₹10,000 are ineligible.

document_title: Advisory on Yellow Mosaic Virus Management in Soybean
text:
### 1. Symptoms & Transmission
- Yellow Mosaic Virus (YMV) causes bright yellow patches alternating with green areas on leaves. In severe cases, the entire leaf turns completely yellow and brittle.
- Seed formation and pod development are severely hampered.
- **Vector**: The virus is transmitted exclusively by Whiteflies (*Bemisia tabaci*), not by soil or mechanical touch.
- In Marathi: सोयाबीनमध्ये पिवळा मोझॅक हा पांढऱ्या माशीद्वारे पसरतो. पानांवर पिवळे पट्टे दिसू लागतात.
- In Hindi: यह रोग सफेद मक्खी द्वारा फैलता है और पत्तियों पर पीले धब्बे बन जाते हैं।

metadata.publisher: ICAR - Indian Institute of Soybean Research (IISR), Indore

document_title: Advisory on Yellow Mosaic Virus Management in Soybean
text:
### 2. Prevention and Management
1. **Rogueing Out**: Immediately uproot and destroy virus-infected plants within the first 30 days of sowing to prevent spread to neighboring healthy crops.
2. **Yellow Sticky Traps**: Place 15 to 20 yellow sticky traps per hectare to monitor and trap whiteflies.
3. **Vector Control (Whitefly management)**:
   - Early stage: Spray Neem Oil 1500 ppm @ 3 ml per litre of water.
   - If whitefly population is high: Spray Thiamethoxam 25% WG @ 4 grams per 10 litres of water, or Acetamiprid 20% SP @ 2 grams per 10 litres of water.
   - **Safety Advisory**: Follow recommended dilutions strictly. Never apply chemical spray during noon heat or rain.

metadata.publisher: ICAR - Indian Institute of Soybean Research (IISR), Indore

document_title: ICAR Advisory on Wheat Crop Management and Yellow Rust
text:
### 1. Critical Stages for Irrigation
Wheat requires 4 to 6 irrigations depending on soil type. The most critical stages are:
1. **Crown Root Initiation (CRI) stage**: 20 to 25 days after sowing (DAS). Most crucial; missing this reduces yield by 25-30%.
2. **Tillering stage**: 40 to 45 DAS.
3. **Jointing / Late tillering stage**: 60 to 65 DAS.
4. **Flowering stage**: 80 to 85 DAS.
5. **Milking stage**: 100 to 105 DAS.
6. **Dough stage**: 115 to 120 DAS.

metadata.publisher: ICAR - Indian Institute of Wheat and Barley Research (IIWBR), Karnal

document_title: ICAR Advisory on Wheat Crop Management and Yellow Rust
text:
### 2. Yellow Rust (Stripe Rust) Diagnosis & Control
- **Symptoms**: Yellow powdery pustules arranged in linear stripes along the leaf veins. When leaves are rubbed with fingers, yellow powder sticks to hands.
- In Hindi: पत्तियों पर पीली धारियां और पीले रंग का पाउडर निकलता है।
- In Marathi: पानांवर पिवळ्या रंगाचे पट्टे दिसतात आणि हाताला पिवळी पावडर लागते.
- **Control Measure**:
  - Spray Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1 ml per litre of water (200 ml in 200 litres of water per acre) as soon as initial symptoms appear.
  - Repeat after 15 days if rust persists.
  - Avoid excess nitrogen fertilizer application which aggravates rust.
